title: Product Manager, Input Zone
description: Product Manager, Input Zone About our Team:- DSM Product is the product management team within Data Source Management (DSM, led by Adrian Scotney), part of Data Operations (led by Kanwar Singh). It is led by the Head of Product Management and owns product management for how publisher content enters the Input Zone, Elsevier’s governed gateway for academic publisher content. This includes technical onboarding, ingestion development, publisher rights data (Salesforce) and the Platform Intelligence reporting that supports content providers. The team is organised around three areas: Platform Intelligence (PLINT), Salesforce/SCM, and the Content Acquisition Liaisons functions that cover ingestion development and technical onboarding. About the Role:- The Product Manager, Input Zone will own the technical onboarding and ingestion-development activities for the Content Acquisition Liaisons group and lead execution of related workstreams. They will own the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow, represent this area within the PM team, and have a solid understanding of content providers and publishers. They will represent their technical needs to the delivery team, prioritise and communicate production issues affecting ingestion or onboarding, and support and participate in demos to key stakeholders at programme milestones. Responsibilities:- Customer Focus Interacts with content providers, publishers, and internal engineering teams during technical onboarding and represents their requirements. Anticipates onboarding and ingestion needs (for example, journal processing moving to the DPOP-601 workflow and the Scopus transition off the legacy OpsBank workflow) and prioritises them for the group. Acts as a named Onboarding Technical Liaison, fielding technical questions from content providers and publishers during negotiation so engineering capacity stays focused on implementation. Focuses on meeting onboarding timelines without compromising the completeness or quality of ingested content. Data-Driven Decision-Making & Analysis Autonomously analyses onboarding, delivery, and completeness-checking data from multiple sources (content providers, engineering, Governance reporting). Compares and evaluates ingestion and onboarding options, and makes recommendations that consider business implications. Uses AI tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, and validates the results before acting on them. Onboarding & Content Acquisition Lifecycle Communicates technical requirements and timelines clearly to negotiation and engineering stakeholders. Coordinates with the LeapSpace negotiation team, system test team, and OpsBank test team on technical onboarding execution once a negotiation concludes. Answers internal and provider-facing questions on ingestion capability, manifest handling, and onboarding scope. Prioritises and communicates production issues and defects affecting ingestion or onboarding, based on relevant data. Product Delivery & Development Lifecycle Leads execution of the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow. Defines and prioritises requirement changes for engineering and performs analysis to meet acceptance criteria. Authors clear, testable specifications (requirements, acceptance criteria, manifest and validation rules) as the shared source of truth for engineering and AI-assisted development, in line with spec-driven development (SDD). Reviews AI-assisted outputs (generated specs, test cases, prototypes) against requirements and is accountable for their quality before they reach engineering. Participates in product discovery and process improvement, and contributes to prototypes (for example, content provider manifest ingestion and PDF identification). Is familiar with SDLCs identified by management, for example agile processes. Strategy & Commercial Acumen Contributes to the strategy and development plans for ingestion and technical onboarding, shared across the roles carrying the Onboarding Technical Liaison responsibility. Understands the operating cost and effort involved in onboarding a new content provider or source. Makes links between personal goals and the team and business strategy. Technical Skills Understands the Input Zone's data and technical architecture — publisher drop zones, ingestion validation, and the downstream handoff — well enough to liaise credibly with engineering. Uses technologies to assist day-to-day tasks (Excel, SQL, Jira, Confluence; familiarity with Salesforce/Snowflake rights data flows and sFTP/S3 publisher landing zones). Has working experience with generative AI tools and AI-assisted development workflows (for example prompt design, specification-to-code generation, AI-supported testing) and understands their limitations, including accuracy, data confidentiality, and publisher-content handling. Ability to engage developers to understand technology constraints. Competencies Personal Capability Practices Self-Development Is curious and keen to learn and develop new ideas, skills, and knowledge. Acts on feedback to improve him/herself. Looks for developmental opportunities in day-to-day work. Invests time and energy in self-development (professional qualifications, relevant reading, networking, keeping up with AI-assisted product and development practices). Solves Problems and Analyses Issues Is able to ask effective questions and collect facts from multiple sources in order to solve problems. Is able to effectively identify and analyse problems and propose solutions. Effectively manages day-to-day issues and problems without intervention. Innovates Brainstorms with others to look for different approaches to current processes and tasks. Looks for opportunities to develop new ideas or thinking within own role. Experiments with new ideas, including applying AI and SDD to onboarding and ingestion workflows, and shares what works with the team. Interpersonal Skills Communicates Powerfully and Prolifically Demonstrates effective conversational skills, including active listening and questioning. Shares information relevant to own role. Participates in team presentations. Collaboration and Teamwork Develops co-operative working relationships within the team. Considers how own style affects others and tailors interactions accordingly. Looks for ways to develop mutually beneficial relationships across teams. Builds Relationships Is approachable and friendly. Asks for opinions of others. Participates in formal and informal gatherings to meet new people and develop new relationships. Inspires and Motivates Others to High Performance Brings enthusiasm to the team. Gets to know others in the team and what is important to them. Observes behaviours and models self after others. Leads by example by performing at high levels. Focus on Results Drives for Results Works hard to achieve objectives. Stays focused on key commitments. Looks to overcome obstacles or barriers to performing. Works with others to achieve joint goals. Requirements: - Suggested minimum years of PM experience: 4-6 years Critical Experiences Recognised as full owner of a technical onboarding, ingestion, or comparable technical-liaison feature area. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks, projects, and priorities, and to work with engineers, content providers, publishers, or negotiation teams to modify or maintain a product and identify technology challenges. Hands-on experience applying AI tools in product management work, such as specification writing, analysis, or prototyping. Experience writing or working from specifications in a spec-driven or specification-first delivery model (preferred). Demonstrated readiness to work under minimal supervision. Education to Qualify Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical subject (Computer Science or an Engineering discipline) is preferred, but not essential. Work in a Way That Works for You:- We promote a healthy work/life balance and provide various well-being initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals to help you meet both your immediate responsibilities and long-term goals. Working for You:- We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer: Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family and parents. Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company. Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones. Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement. Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work-life balance. Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work-related challenges. Medical Screening: Your well-being is a top priority. Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity and adoption support. Long-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment. New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood. Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates. Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave and Gazetted Public Holidays. Free transport pick up and drop from home - office - home. Applicable for Bangalore and Chennai. About Business:- We are a global leader in information and analytics, helping researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science, research, health education, interactive learning and exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to addressing the world's grand challenges and creating a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare, partnering for a better world. Elsevier is a global information analytics business that helps institutions and professionals progress science, advance healthcare, open science and improve performance for the benefit of humanity.  

We help researchers make new discoveries, collaborate with their colleagues, and give them the knowledge they need to find funding. We help governments and universities evaluate and improve their research strategies. We help doctors save lives, providing insight for physicians to find the right clinical answers, and we support nurses and other healthcare professionals throughout their careers.

Elsevier provides digital solutions and tools in the areas of strategic research management, R&D performance, clinical decision support, and professional education; including ScienceDirect, Scopus, ClinicalKey and Sherpath. 

Elsevier publishes over 2,500 digitized journals, including The Lancet and Cell, more than 35,000 e-book titles and iconic reference works, including Gray’s Anatomy.
